documents: ሊታተሙ የታሰቡት መረጃዎች (ሰንጠረዦች ወይም ፋይሎች)
steps: ከኤጀንሲው ጋር የይዘት፣ የግላዊነትና የቅርጸት ግምገማ

om.title: Deeggarsa qophii fi maxxansa daataa banaa
om.summary: Waajjiraaleen mootummaa daataa isaanii qopheessanii, ibsanii fi akka daataa banaatti akka maxxansan, akkasumas agarsiistota dijitaalaa akka gabaasan deeggaruu.
documents: Daataa maxxanfamuuf karoorfame (gabatee ykn faayilii)
steps: Ejjansicha waliin sakatta'iinsa qabiyyee, dhuunfaa fi bifaa

en.title: Digital literacy training
en.summary: Basic computer, internet and online-service skills for civil servants, young people, women and other residents.
en.eligibility: Residents of the region and civil servants.
documents: For a group: a request letter with the number of participants
steps: Register, or send a group request
You are placed in a training round

am.title: የዲጂታል ዕውቀት ሥልጠና
am.summary: ለመንግሥት ሠራተኞች፣ ለወጣቶች፣ ለሴቶችና ለሌሎች ነዋሪዎች መሠረታዊ የኮምፒውተር፣ የኢንተርኔትና የኦንላይን አገልግሎት አጠቃቀም ክህሎት።
documents: ለቡድን፦ የተሳታፊዎችን ብዛት የሚገልጽ የጥያቄ ደብዳቤ

om.title: Leenjii beekumsa dijitaalaa
om.summary: Dandeettii bu'uuraa kompiitaraa, interneetii fi tajaajila interneetaa itti fayyadamuu hojjettoota mootummaa, dargaggoota, dubartootaa fi jiraattota birootiif.
documents: Gareef: xalayaa gaaffii baay'ina hirmaattotaa ibsu

en.title: AI clubs and youth technology camps
en.summary: Artificial intelligence and coding clubs in schools, and holiday technology camps for teenagers, following the model the Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute runs in other regions.
en.eligibility: Secondary schools and young people in the region; camps by age group.
documents: For a school club: a request letter from the school
For a camp: a parent's or guardian's consent
steps: The school asks for a club, or a young person registers for a camp
Sessions with mentors (machine learning, programming, robotics)
A showcase of the participants' projects

am.title: የሰው ሠራሽ አስተውሎት ክለቦችና የወጣቶች የቴክኖሎጂ ካምፖች
am.summary: በትምህርት ቤቶች የሰው ሠራሽ አስተውሎትና የፕሮግራሚንግ ክለቦች፣ እንዲሁም ለታዳጊዎች የዕረፍት ጊዜ የቴክኖሎጂ ካምፖች፤ የኢትዮጵያ አርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ኢንስቲትዩት በሌሎች ክልሎች በሚያካሂደው አሠራር መሠረት።
am.eligibility: በክልሉ ያሉ የሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤቶችና ወጣቶች፤ ካምፖች በዕድሜ ቡድን ይዘጋጃሉ።
documents: ለትምህርት ቤት ክለብ፦ ከትምህርት ቤቱ የጥያቄ ደብዳቤ
ለካምፕ፦ የወላጅ ወይም የአሳዳጊ ፈቃድ
steps: ትምህርት ቤቱ ክለብ ይጠይቃል ወይም ወጣቱ ለካምፕ ይመዘገባል
ከአማካሪዎች ጋር ሥልጠና (ማሽን ለርኒንግ፣ ፕሮግራሚንግ፣ ሮቦቲክስ)

om.title: Kilabota AI fi kaampii teeknooloojii dargaggootaa
om.summary: Kilabota sammuu namtolchee fi koodii mana barumsaa keessatti, akkasumas kaampii teeknooloojii yeroo boqonnaa dargaggootaaf, akkaataa Inistiitiyuutiin Sammuu Namtolchee Itoophiyaa naannolee biroo keessatti hojjetuun.
om.eligibility: Mana barumsaa sadarkaa lammaffaa fi dargaggoota naannichaa; kaampiin garee umuriitiin qophaa'a.
documents: Kilaba mana barumsaatiif: xalayaa gaaffii mana barumsichaa irraa
Kaampiif: hayyama maatii ykn guddisaa
steps: Manni barumsaa kilaba gaafata, ykn dargaggoon kaampiif galmaa'a
Leenjii gorsitoota waliin (machine learning, koodii, roobootiksii)

en.title: Training in emerging technologies (AI, IoT, cybersecurity)
en.summary: Short courses in artificial intelligence, the internet of things, cybersecurity, software development and other emerging technologies.
en.eligibility: Civil servants, graduates, students and innovators who meet each course's entry level.
documents: A copy of your education certificate (if the course asks for it)
steps: Take the entry assessment if the course has one
Attend the course and complete the practical work

am.title: በአዳዲስ ቴክኖሎጂዎች ሥልጠና (ሰው ሠራሽ አስተውሎት፣ IoT፣ ሳይበር ደህንነት)
am.summary: በሰው ሠራሽ አስተውሎት፣ በነገሮች ኢንተርኔት (IoT)፣ በሳይበር ደህንነት፣ በሶፍትዌር ልማትና በሌሎች አዳዲስ ቴክኖሎጂዎች አጫጭር ኮርሶች።
am.eligibility: የእያንዳንዱን ኮርስ የመግቢያ ደረጃ የሚያሟሉ የመንግሥት ሠራተኞች፣ ተመራቂዎች፣ ተማሪዎችና የፈጠራ ባለሙያዎች።
documents: የትምህርት ማስረጃ ቅጂ (ኮርሱ ከጠየቀ)

om.title: Leenjii teeknooloojiiwwan haaraa (AI, IoT, nageenya saayibarii)
om.summary: Koorsiiwwan gabaabaa sammuu namtolchee (AI), interneetii wantootaa (IoT), nageenya saayibarii, misooma sooftiweeriitii fi teeknooloojiiwwan haaraa biroo.
om.eligibility: Hojjettoota mootummaa, eebbifamtoota, barattootaa fi kalaqxota sadarkaa seensa koorsii tokkoon tokkoon guutan.
documents: Garagalcha ragaa barnootaa (yoo koorsichi gaafate)
steps: Yoo koorsichi qormaata seensaa qabaate fudhadhaa

en.title: Support for startups and innovators
en.summary: Advice, mentoring and incubation for innovators and startups, and an orientation on startup labelling under the national Startup Proclamation (the label itself is given by the Ministry of Innovation and Technology). AI startups are also pointed to national programmes such as the Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute's incubation centre.
en.eligibility: Innovators, students and startups in the region.
documents: A short description of the idea or the business
The founders' contacts
steps: First meeting with the innovation team
Follow-up, and links to finance and partners

am.title: ለጀማሪ ኩባንያዎችና ለፈጠራ ባለሙያዎች ድጋፍ
am.summary: ለፈጠራ ባለሙያዎችና ለጀማሪ ኩባንያዎች ምክር፣ የማማከርና የማቀፊያ (incubation) ድጋፍ፣ እንዲሁም በብሔራዊ የጀማሪ ኩባንያዎች አዋጅ መሠረት ስለሚሰጠው መለያ ገለጻ (መለያውን የሚሰጠው የኢኖቬሽንና ቴክኖሎጂ ሚኒስቴር ነው)። የሰው ሠራሽ አስተውሎት ጀማሪ ኩባንያዎች እንደ ኢትዮጵያ አርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ኢንስቲትዩት የማቀፊያ ማዕከል ወዳሉ ብሔራዊ ፕሮግራሞችም ይመራሉ።
am.eligibility: በክልሉ ያሉ የፈጠራ ባለሙያዎች፣ ተማሪዎችና ጀማሪ ኩባንያዎች።
documents: የሐሳቡ ወይም የንግዱ አጭር መግለጫ
የመሥራቾች አድራሻ

om.title: Deeggarsa jalqabbiiwwan daldalaa fi kalaqxootaaf
om.summary: Gorsa, deeggarsa leenjisummaa (mentoring) fi inkubeeshinii kalaqxotaa fi jalqabbiiwwan daldalaatiif, akkasumas ibsa mallattoo jalqabbii daldalaa Labsii Jalqabbiiwwan Daldalaa biyyoolessaa jalatti kennamu (mallattoo kan kennu Ministeera Kalaqaa fi Teeknooloojii dha). Jalqabbiiwwan daldalaa AI gara sagantaalee biyyoolessaa kan akka giddugala inkubeeshinii Inistiitiyuutii Sammuu Namtolchee Itoophiyaattis ni qajeelfamu.
om.eligibility: Kalaqxota, barattootaa fi jalqabbiiwwan daldalaa naannicha keessa jiran.
documents: Ibsa gabaabaa yaadaa ykn daldalaa
Teessoo hundeessitootaa
steps: Hordoffii fi walitti hidhamiinsa faayinaansii fi michootaa

en.title: Registering and showcasing innovations
en.summary: Registering innovations and technologies made in the region, and giving them a chance to be shown at exhibitions and to the offices that could use them.
en.eligibility: Individuals, teams and institutions in the region with an innovation or technology.
documents: A description of the innovation, with photos or a video
steps: An invitation to show it at an exhibition or to pilot it with an office

am.title: የፈጠራ ሥራዎች ምዝገባና ማስተዋወቅ
am.summary: በክልሉ የተሠሩ የፈጠራ ሥራዎችንና ቴክኖሎጂዎችን መመዝገብ፣ በኤግዚቢሽኖች ላይ እንዲቀርቡና ሊጠቀሙባቸው ከሚችሉ መሥሪያ ቤቶች ጋር እንዲተሳሰሩ ዕድል መፍጠር።
am.eligibility: በክልሉ የፈጠራ ሥራ ወይም ቴክኖሎጂ ያላቸው ግለሰቦች፣ ቡድኖችና ተቋማት።
documents: የፈጠራ ሥራው መግለጫ ከፎቶዎች ወይም ከቪዲዮ ጋር
steps: በኤግዚቢሽን ለማቅረብ ወይም ከመሥሪያ ቤት ጋር ለመሞከር ግብዣ

om.title: Galmeessaa fi beeksisa kalaqaa
om.summary: Kalaqaa fi teeknooloojiiwwan naannicha keessatti hojjetaman galmeessuu, agarsiisa irratti akka dhiyaatanii fi waajjiraalee itti fayyadamuu danda'an waliin akka walqunnaman carraa uumuu.
om.eligibility: Namoota dhuunfaa, gareewwanii fi dhaabbilee naannicha keessatti kalaqa ykn teeknooloojii qaban.
documents: Ibsa kalaqichaa suuraa ykn viidiyoo waliin
steps: Agarsiisa irratti dhiyeessuuf ykn waajjira waliin yaaluuf affeerraa

en.title: Cybersecurity awareness for public offices
en.summary: Awareness sessions, guides and basic security checks so that public offices and residents use digital services safely. National cyber incidents are reported to INSA.
en.eligibility: Regional public offices, schools and community groups.
documents: The number of participants and a suitable date
steps: Request a session for your office
Agree the date and the audience
A follow-up checklist for the office

am.title: ለመንግሥት መሥሪያ ቤቶች የሳይበር ደህንነት ግንዛቤ
am.summary: የመንግሥት መሥሪያ ቤቶችና ነዋሪዎች ዲጂታል አገልግሎቶችን በደህንነት እንዲጠቀሙ የግንዛቤ ማስጨበጫ፣ መመሪያዎችና መሠረታዊ የደህንነት ፍተሻዎች። ብሔራዊ የሳይበር ጥቃቶች ለኢንሳ (INSA) ሪፖርት ይደረጋሉ።
am.eligibility: የክልሉ የመንግሥት መሥሪያ ቤቶች፣ ትምህርት ቤቶችና የማኅበረሰብ ቡድኖች።
documents: የተሳታፊዎች ብዛትና የሚመች ቀን

om.title: Hubannoo nageenya saayibarii waajjiraalee mootummaaf
om.summary: Waajjiraaleen mootummaa fi jiraattonni tajaajiloota dijitaalaa nageenyaan akka itti fayyadamaniif marii hubannoo, qajeelfamootaa fi sakatta'iinsa nageenyaa bu'uuraa. Haleellaan saayibarii biyyoolessaa INSA-tti gabaafama.
om.eligibility: Waajjiraalee mootummaa naannichaa, mana barumsaa fi gareewwan hawaasaa.
documents: Baay'ina hirmaattotaa fi guyyaa mijatu
steps: Guyyaa fi hirmaattota irratti walii galaa
